mechanism: Meta deploys AI compute and networking to improve recommendations, engagement, advertising returns, content tools and messaging monetization; shareholder value appears only when incremental revenue and margins exceed infrastructure, talent, financing, stock-compensation and Reality Labs costs.
catalyst: AI-driven engagement and advertiser returns remain measurable, advertising and messaging revenue compound, infrastructure utilization and margins improve, capital spending normalizes, and per-share free-cash-flow conversion recovers.
invalidation: AI investment does not produce durable engagement, advertising or messaging economics sufficient to offset capital spending, depreciation, debt and stock compensation; regulation impairs monetization; or Reality Labs and legal costs absorb the benefit.
